says: a trip: a step in one frame that no movement makes, to within 120 units of a teleporter's exit. A jump as he comes out: 150 or more upward speed within 0.2 s of the exit; its landing: the first ground after it within 1.5 s (cells of 48 x 48 x 32, gathered within 96 units). A teleporter jump: a landing spot of 10 jumps or more that at most 2% of the trips without the jump pass within 64 units of in their 1.5 s (20 such trips or more; fewer: only_with_a_jump is null). Teleporters they jump out of: three trips in four or more. High take-offs: 300 to 480 upward speed with no rocket, grenade or plasma of his and no damage to him in the 0.3 s before and no teleporter (a plain jump gives 275): places with 20 or more; a jump pad is among them; a take-off counts whether the ground flag shows it or he came down and went up again between two snapshots. Take-offs with a weapon: 300 or more upward speed with his own rocket, grenade or plasma in the 0.3 s before: places with 10 or more. Jumps that come down higher: plain jumps whose landing is 50 units or more above the take-off (the plain jump's top is 47, so a step was taken in the air): places with 20 or more
